Nadia (CS): Heads-up: Solstice (pilot) asked for a one-page preflight for their exec demo next Tue. They want a tiny ops checklist + a 2-question pulse we can hand to execs. Can SRE/SE help assemble?
Owen (SRE): I can. Quick Qs: streaming vs single-shot? Expected peak concurrency?
ClientOps (Customer): Streaming chat. Typical user turn ~70 tokens. Peak ~48 concurrent. We run an embedding backfill nightly at 02:00 but can move it +1h.
Pri (Solutions Eng): For that profile: prereq = preheat KV cache, set streaming.flush_ms=35, batching.target_tokens=6 OR batching.max_wait_ms=25, and sample outputs 1% for hallucination monitoring. For demo routes prefer shorter flushes to keep UX snappy.
Marta (PM): Renewal note: good demo outcomes increase expansion likelihood. Suggest gating: 99th < 230ms AND error rate < 0.5% across demo window for two demos -> green. If not, amber and SE follow-up.
Owen (SRE): Ops checklist (two-minute read) draft: 
- Run preheat script 6m before demo start (snippet below).
- Set demo route streaming.flush_ms = 35.
- Set batching.target_tokens = 6 / max_wait_ms = 25.
- Autoscale spike +30% from -5m to +20m; undo after +30m.
- Shift nightly embedding job +1h if possible.
- Capture Console latency screenshot & enable 1% output sampling.

Preheat snippet:
```
# one-click preheat for demo
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prompts":["Hello","Show me my summary","Invite a teammate"]}'
```

Pri (Solutions Eng): Embeddings note: run large batches off-peak, chunk to 500-700 vectors/batch. Use exponential retry for 429s starting at 200ms. Also add lightweight output sampling to capture any strange model replies during live demo.
Nadia (CS): Exec pulse (2 Qs): 1) Responsiveness (1-5). 2) Any incorrect/confusing outputs? (Y/N + short). Ask for Console latency screenshot for demo route. Keep it tiny for execs.
Owen (SRE): Health gating process: CS marks account green if gating metrics met for two demos within 14 days. If metric fails once -> amber and SE engagement. If still amber after fixes -> flag at-risk for renewal.
PreflightBot: Reminder set: "Solstice preheat" at 2026-05-05T09:54:00Z (owner: Nadia). :bell:
ClientOps (Customer): We'll shift the embed job +1h and run the preheat script. Please include the 1-click link in the one-pager.
Nadia (CS): Action owners: Nadia -> assemble one-pager + exec pulse; Owen -> infra ticket for autoscale & healthcheck; Pri -> prime link + embedding notes; Marta -> track renewal gating. Everyone confirm by EOD?
Owen (SRE): Confirmed. I'll post infra ticket link when done.
Pri (Solutions Eng): Confirmed. I'll include dry-run offer and runbook snippet for their ops.
Nadia (CS): Thanks team :sparkles: We'll collect post-demo feedback and fold lessons into the shared CS runbook (demo-preflight bank).
